title: Contractual structure and hierarchy of documents

statement.en: The rulebook shall specify the matters to be agreed between participants, its contractual structure (constitutive or accession agreement, rulebook, terms of use) and the hierarchy of the documents; which instruments it uses is Level 1.

control: The rulebook states the matters to agree, the contractual structure and the hierarchy of documents

expressions.note: Rulebook and agreements checked by people.
